description:
Save a named custom field set as a reusable task type (#103 Phase B).

Once saved, submit against it by passing its returned id as 'task_type' to handinloop_submit_extraction_job — no need to re-send the fields each time. Saved types also appear in handinloop_list_task_types. Saving an existing id updates it.

Needs an API key with the 'workflows' scope (#951), which no key has unless an organisation admin or engineer ticked it when making the key: a saved type changes what every later job of the account extracts. Without it the call fails with the missing scope named; ask a person to issue a key with 'workflows' rather than retrying.

Not for onboarding a client: draft a plan with handinloop_draft_onboarding_plan instead, which a person approves before anything changes.

Args:
  - fields: [{ name, description? }] — the field set (required, at least one).
  - name (optional): human name; the id is derived from it if 'id' is omitted.
  - id (optional): stable handle (lowercase letter then letters/digits/underscores). Must not collide with a built-in.
  - description (optional).
  - prompt_template (optional): instructions sent to the extraction model with every document of this type, e.g. "Dates are day-first; ignore the remittance slip." Up to 4000 characters. Omit to keep the saved one; "" clears it.
  - gate (optional): { critical_fields?: string[], min_confidence?: number } — fields a person must sign off on every document of this type (each must be one of 'fields'), and a confidence floor. A submit's own 'verify' is merged with it, stricter wins. Omit to keep the saved one; {} clears it.

Returns the saved TaskType { id, name, description, output_fields, prompt_template?, gate?, review_policy? }. review_policy (#585: the type's confidence threshold and QA sample rate) is read-only here: an organisation admin or engineer sets it in the portal, and a save keeps it.

fields.description: The field set to save (at least one)

gate.description: Fields a person must sign off on every document of this type; {} clears

id.description: Stable handle; derived from name if omitted

prompt_template.description: Instructions to the extraction model for every document of this type; "" clears

name: handinloop_save_task_type
title: Save a Reusable Task Type
